theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmRaw_comm_adjacent_one {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) :
jmRaw H 1 * jmRaw H 2 = jmRaw H 2 * jmRaw H 1

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmRaw_two_mul_one {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) :
jmRaw H 2 * jmRaw H 1 = (HeckeGenerators.σ q 1 * HeckeGenerators.σ q 0) ^ 3

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.fullTwist3_symm {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) :
(HeckeGenerators.σ q 0 * HeckeGenerators.σ q 1) ^ 3 = (HeckeGenerators.σ q 1 * HeckeGenerators.σ q 0) ^ 3

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmRaw_hook {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (k : ℕ) :
1 ≤ k → jmRaw H k = descProd H k * (HeckeGenerators.σ q 0 * HeckeGenerators.σ q 0) * ascProd H k

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.ascProd_succ {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
ascProd H (k + 1) = ascProd H k * HeckeGenerators.σ q k

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.descProd_succ {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
descProd H (k + 1) = HeckeGenerators.σ q k * descProd H k

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.ascProd_one {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) :
ascProd H 1 = 1

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.descProd_one {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) :
descProd H 1 = 1

def QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.ascProd {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) :
ℕ → A

def QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.descProd {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) :
ℕ → A

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmRaw_comm_sigma_far {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (i j : ℕ) :
i < j → HeckeGenerators.σ q j * jmRaw H i = jmRaw H i * HeckeGenerators.σ q j

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.sigma_mul_jm_prod {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (i : ℕ) :
HeckeGenerators.σ q i * (jmRaw H i * jmRaw H (i + 1)) = jmRaw H (i + 1) * jmRaw H i * HeckeGenerators.σ q i

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.sigma_comm_add {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (i : ℕ) :
HeckeGenerators.σ q i * (jmRaw H i + jmRaw H (i + 1)) = (jmRaw H i + jmRaw H (i + 1)) * HeckeGenerators.σ q i

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jm_succ_mul_sigma {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (i : ℕ) :
jmRaw H (i + 1) * HeckeGenerators.σ q i = (q - q⁻¹) • jmRaw H (i + 1) + HeckeGenerators.σ q i * jmRaw H i

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.sigma_mul_jm_succ {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (i : ℕ) :
HeckeGenerators.σ q i * jmRaw H (i + 1) = (q - q⁻¹) • jmRaw H (i + 1) + jmRaw H i * HeckeGenerators.σ q i
